findings.title: 90 PHPStan level max typing errors across Eloquent models, DTOs, and Console commands
findings.description: Static analysis detected missing generic annotations on Eloquent relationships (BelongsTo, HasMany), missing generic types on ArrayAccess in RawContentItem, unsafe string casting in Console commands, and unannotated array shape casts.
findings.evidence: PHPStan reported 90 errors at level max (missingType.generics, missingType.iterableValue, cast.string, argument.type).
findings.recommendation: Add full PHPDoc generic annotations to model relationships, specify array shapes and generics for ArrayAccess, and cleanly type console command option resolution.
